model: google/embeddinggemma-2 text encoder (24-layer Gemma text stack with per-layer inputs, sliding + full attention, mean pool + L2 normalize); HF snapshot 914f7f89142e33e77833254d9c9b90c3cef7303b
workload: text-encoder prefill, one forward per request; vision and audio towers out of scope

checkout.commit_note: stage-1 base commit; harness commit 7ef04f02da (tests/perf/prefill*.py, no model code change); baseline docs commit logged in doc/prefill/01-baseline/work_log.md

hardware.part: Blackhole P150a (tt-smi board_type p150a, board_id 0000040331911033, bus 0000:01:00.0)
hardware.power_limits_detail: TDP limit 150 W (tt-smi limits.tdp_limit, TDP_LIMIT_MAX 0x96; hwmon power1_max 150000000 uW), TDC limit 200 A (curr1_max), board power limit 300 W (BOARD_POWER_LIMIT 0x12c), AICLK max 1350 MHz (AICLK_LIMIT_MAX 0x546). Default limits, not changed; optimize at these.
hardware.host: sjc-snva-tp100, Ubuntu 22.04.5, kernel 6.8.0-138, 24 cores, 61 GB RAM

shapes_note: seq is the physical bucket (tt/config.py SEQ_BUCKETS); 65536 is the max-cap bucket (doc/context_contract.json supported_max_seq_len). masked = a real input (tests/common.make_batch corpus, offset 0) of logical_len = 3/4 of the bucket, right-padded into the bucket, so 1/4 of the keys are padding (dense additive masks; device work does not depend on logical_len). No unmasked path exists: there is no no-mask path with an explicit caller contract.

metric.definition: ms per traced warmed forward: execute_trace replays on resident inputs, one trace per bucket (TextEncoder.capture_all), timed per window with one sync per window (tests/perf/prefill.py)
metric.target_rule: no absolute targets supplied; the metric is improvement vs the stage-1 sustained baseline in doc/prefill/01-baseline/perf_summary.json

reference.device: none supplied (no reference-GPU numbers; none are invented)
reference.settings: accuracy reference only: HF transformers EmbeddingGemma2TextModel, fp32, CPU, sdpa attention, unpadded [1, logical_len] input (tests/perf/prefill_refs.py)

accuracy.pcc_gate_metric: last-hidden PCC over the logical_len valid rows of the traced replay output vs HF fp32 (hard)
accuracy.embedding_cosine_metric: pooled + normalized embedding cosine of the traced replay output vs HF fp32

open_decisions.b1_s256: measured stage-1 gate failure, no override applied: last-hidden PCC 0.98872 < 0.99 (embedding cosine 0.99763) with the selected text precision p3_qkv_gu on the contract input (logical 192, corpus offset 0); the E5a baseline precision gives 0.99692 on the same input at +6.6 % burst latency for this bucket. Options and evidence: doc/prefill/01-baseline/README.md, 'Gate failure at b1_s256'. Orchestrator decides (stage-7 precision change, precision revert, or a pcc_gate_override with this reason).

accuracy.references: cached once under tt-ops/runs/embeddinggemma-2/e9/refs/ (host RAM and time per bucket in doc/prefill/01-baseline/README.md)
accuracy.existing_tests: per-layer PCC tests (>= 0.995) and every existing test in MODEL_DIR/tests keep passing unchanged
accuracy.task_eval: none (person's decision: no MTEB / lm-eval / AIME)

regime.headline: sustained
regime.sustained_definition: back-to-back replays in ~500 ms windows for max(30 s, 300 replays); median of the windows in the last third of the run; AICLK / power / current / vcore / temperature sampled every 100 ms from sysfs in a second process
regime.burst_definition: 5 windows, each after 3 s idle, of n back-to-back replays (n = 200 ms / forward, clamped to 3 ... 20); median / avg / best of the windows

harness: models/demos/blackhole/embedding_gemma2/tests/perf/prefill.py (EMBEDDING_GEMMA2_PREFILL_ALL=1 for the full stage-1 sweep); profiles: tests/perf/perf.py::test_tracy_forward[b1_s<bucket>]
